content:
nicole_cs: Heads-up — Mosaic renewal asking for split billing across Mosaic US (primary) and Mosaic EU (secondary). They want to start provisioning ASAP with a CC deposit but procurement requires a PO for the subscription. EU procurement also insists on a witnessing clause. Can we support CC-first, PO-follow, and an e-witness addendum?

raj_sales: They're comfortable with the price if we accept split invoices. PO ETA ~3 business days. CC deposit will unblock onboarding. Customer prefers e-witness over wet witness.

tayla_fin: Finance can accept card for deposit (auth-only) and finalize once PO is uploaded. Need vendor codes + tax/VAT for both entities. We'll mark invoice metadata: po: TBD, billing_split: US:75, EU:25, deposit: card_auth.

noah_legal: E-witness should be fine; I'll draft a 1-paragraph Witness Addendum that references the signing audit trail (name + email). Also request procurement email be on the DocuSign envelope.

nicole_cs: I'll message buyer: "We can do CC deposit + PO within 5 business days. We'll include an e-witness addendum and capture procurement email on the envelope. Please provide vendor codes and the PO when available."

(docusign-bot): Template found: "Renewal-Split-Billing-EWitness". Reply with "create envelope" to generate envelope with witness field and invoice metadata.

raj_sales: Confirmed buyer OK with e-witness. They will provide vendor codes and PO in ~72 hrs. Charge CC after signature.

tayla_fin: Finance approve conditional provisioning. We'll add note: "Provisioning conditional on PO upload within 5 business days; otherwise refund deposit." Also require procurement approval email captured.

noah_legal: Draft clause: "Witness Addendum: For the EU legal entity, execution via electronic witness (name and email recorded in the signing audit trail) will satisfy witnessing requirements. Parties agree e-witness records are binding." OK to attach.

nicole_cs: Plan: create envelope with addendum + split invoice fields, send to buyer, charge card auth post-signature, wait for PO. Proceeding unless objections.

(docusign-bot): Envelope created: https://docusign.example/envelope/0xdef-mosaic-split-ewitness. Routing: 1) Mosaic EU signer (e-witness) -> 2) Mosaic US signer -> 3) Procurement CC -> 4) Finance ack.

raj_sales: Sent to buyer. I'll follow up on PO ETA to hit provisioning window.

nicole_cs: Thanks team — I'll update here when signed or when PO lands. :white_check_mark:
